actions.neutral: Both empty hands naturally relaxed/half-open near upper waist and chest, visible fingertips where gauntlets allow; no virtual mechanical loop/handle grip. Stance braced but fully upright.
actions.idle: Small breathing/armor-weight shift, empty command hand remains relaxed; no held-chain tension or mechanical grip.
actions.run: True alternate legs; empty remote-command forearm swings modestly while free arm counterbalances; no imagined device attached to wrist, no drag/pull pose.
cast-single-target: free hand forms short chest seal
dominant empty command palm raises and locks, deliberate brace
dominant OPEN palm pushes command toward facing direction at release
steady restrained command-palm follow-through while free hand braces
complete fully upright original neutral recovery, no hand gripping a loop
cast-aoe: both empty hands form compact chest seal
separate hands slightly and lock command stance
broad two-hand outward/downward OPEN-palm command release, keep head view
hold low open palms/brace while sequential stomp facts happen outside body
complete fully upright original neutral recovery
actions.hit: Six keys: small flinch, recoil, knees bend, empty open-hand brace, rise, fully upright neutral recovery. No chain-pull or vehicle impact/weapon drawn.
actions.death: Six keys: stagger, knees buckle, sideways fall, body-ground contact, settle, fully lying terminal corpse. Device remains separate at locked ground origin; no pulling device into corpse/hand, no gore.
actions.meditate: Six REAL lotus-seated breathing keys, folded legs, empty open or clasped seal hands naturally on lap, every key already seated. Mechanical device is outside source and stays ground-rooted.
actions.gather: Six keys: begin bend, lower one knee, reach empty action hand to ground, lift empty hand, inspect empty palm, complete fully upright neutral recovery. No material/item/commandchain/vehicle in hand.
